configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Release build with tests + benchmarks. No sanitizers. Used by CI's primary build job and `make build-propagator`. Generator is platform-default: Visual Studio on Windows, Makefiles or Ninja on Linux/macOS (override locally via `CMAKE_GENERATOR` env var or a CMakeUserPresets.json).

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build with AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. Used by CI's debug build job to catch memory + UB bugs. NOTE: UBSan is not supported on MSVC at the time of writing; on Windows the debug preset enables ASan only (UBSan flag is a no-op).

buildPresets.name: debug
buildPresets.description: Debug build with sanitizers (configure preset: debug).

testPresets.name: default
testPresets.description: GoogleTest suite (Release). Used by CI's `ctest --preset default --output-on-failure`.

testPresets.name: debug
testPresets.description: GoogleTest suite (Debug + sanitizers). ASan reports surface here.
